-->

Make `InstrumenterBuilder.setSchemaUrl(...)` the only source of the schema URL shared by spans, operation metrics, and exception logs. The schema identifies the conventions defining those signals, independent of supporting attributes.

```diff
 Instrumenter.<Request, Response>builder(openTelemetry, "my-instrumentation", spanNameExtractor)
+    .setSchemaUrl("https://opentelemetry.io/schemas/1.41.0")
     .addAttributesExtractor(attributesExtractor)
     .buildInstrumenter();
```

**Breaking change:** Builders that relied on attribute-derived schemas must add the setter shown above. Without it, telemetry has no schema URL in any mode. Explicit custom URLs remain supported.

Fourth and final layer on #20760, tracking #20755.
metadata.title: Require explicit Instrumenter schema selection
